explanation: It is named after Saint Cyril, a 9th-century missionary, though his followers in the First Bulgarian Empire probably created it. Bulgarian, Serbian and Ukrainian are written in Cyrillic too.

claims.text: The Russian alphabet is a form of the Cyrillic script.
The Russian alphabet is not the Glagolitic, Greek or Latin script.
The Cyrillic script is named after Saint Cyril, a 9th-century Byzantine missionary.
Cyrillic was probably created by followers of Cyril and Methodius in the First Bulgarian Empire.
Bulgarian, Serbian and Ukrainian are written in Cyrillic.
